name: CR1225

dimensions.note: Panasonic BR1225 datasheet publishes maximum dimensions only; nominal is set to the maximum. The CR1225 size code gives the same values.

variants.notes: No CR1225 datasheet was located, so capacity and weight are not published here.

variants.label: BR1225

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.03 mA continuous standard drain; cutoff not stated

variants.notes: BR1225 is a lithium-carbon-monofluoride cell in the same case. It has a flatter discharge curve and lower pulse capability than the CR type, and lower rated drain.

interchange.note: Same diameter and 0.5 mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR1225 holder.
Same diameter and 0.9 mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR1225 holder.

Button batteries and other swallowed batteries

safety: Swallowed coin cells can cause severe internal burns within two hours. Keep batteries away from children, and seek emergency medical care immediately if one is swallowed or placed in the nose or ears.
In the United States, the National Battery Ingestion Hotline is 1-800-498-8666 and Poison Help is 1-800-222-1222.
Do not recharge, crush, puncture, heat or short-circuit a primary lithium coin cell.
